entities.summary: Nick Jr. is a children's pay television channel in the United Kingdom and Ireland owned and operated by Paramount Networks UK & Australia. Aimed at preschoolers, it launched as the first full-day preschool-oriented television channel in the United Kingdom and all of Europe on 1 September 1999.
